style: Flat 2D storybook illustration, bold simplified shapes with clean edges, soft cel shading, subtle paper grain. Warm palette of ochre, terracotta and sand with deep teal shadows, strong warm rim light. Ancient Mesopotamia around 3100 BC: mudbrick, reeds, clay; men are bare-chested with knee-length wool kilts and shaved heads. Vertical composition with the main subject in the upper two thirds. No text, no letters, no watermark.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a man's fingers rolling a small carved stone cylinder, the size of a thumb, across a palm-sized slab of wet clay. Behind the cylinder a raised band of tiny carved animal figures appears in the clay. Low side light makes the relief glow, dark background.
A small carved stone cylinder falling and sinking into dark river water among reeds at dusk, a ring of ripples around it, a few bubbles, the stone half swallowed by shadow. Lonely, quiet mood.

Wide view of an early Sumerian city at sunrise: a white mudbrick temple on a high terrace above flat-roofed houses, palm trees and a canal. In the foreground a line of workers carries heavy baskets of golden barley on their shoulders toward a storehouse. Long shadows, glowing sky.

Inside a mudbrick storehouse, a worried administrator stands between towering heaps of golden barley and rows of big clay jars, hands on his head, overwhelmed. Shafts of sunlight fall through a high window, dust in the air. Medium shot.

Close-up over the shoulder of a scribe: his hand holds a cut reed stylus and draws a simple picture of a barley stalk into a small pillow-shaped slab of soft wet clay held in his other palm. Warm lamp light, shallow dark background.

A queue of tired workers holding out clay bowls while an official pours golden barley grain from a jar into the first bowl. A scribe sits beside him with a small clay tablet. Courtyard of a mudbrick temple, late afternoon light. Medium wide shot.

A scribe sits cross-legged, scratching his shaved head and frowning at a small clay tablet in his hand that shows only a single drawing of a barley stalk. Around him stand many identical clay jars. Slightly comic, puzzled expression. Medium close shot.

Macro close-up of the round end of a reed stylus pressing deep circular holes in a neat row into soft wet clay, three holes already made, a fourth being pressed. Hard grazing light, deep shadows inside the holes, fingers visible at the top edge.

Two men face each other in a doorway, in profile. The man on the left holds up a small clay tablet; the man on the right narrows his eyes and points at it with suspicion, arms tense. Between them a strong shaft of light. Dramatic stand-off, medium shot.

Close-up of a bearded temple official's chest and hands: a small carved stone cylinder seal hangs on a cord around his neck and he lifts it with two fingers, proud and deliberate. Warm rim light on the stone, dark teal background.

Top-down view of a hand rolling a small carved stone cylinder across the back of a palm-sized clay tablet lying on a reed mat. A long continuous band of raised figures, a man, dogs and boars, unrolls behind the cylinder. Strong raking light from the left.

A hunting scene in a reed marsh: a man in a kilt strides forward holding two lean hunting dogs straining on leashes, chasing two bristling wild boars that crash through tall reeds and shallow water. Side view like a frieze, everything moving left to right, golden backlight, splashes.

A dim archive room with wooden shelves and baskets filled with hundreds of small clay tablets. A scribe places one more tablet on a shelf. A single oil lamp lights his face and the nearest tablets, deep teal darkness beyond. Medium wide shot.

An open empty human palm held out toward the viewer, a little dust drifting off it in a beam of warm light, as if something small that lay there has just vanished. Dark teal background, quiet and still.

A palm-sized pillow-shaped clay tablet resting in two cupped hands, its surface crossed by a raised band of tiny figures of a man, dogs and boars. Warm glowing light on the clay, dark background, reverent mood. Close-up.
